title: Report and evidence filtering
responsibility: Classifies viewport sizes and filters report galleries and project lists.

inputs.name: galleryEvidence.items
inputs.description: Evidence items to choose gallery representatives from.

inputs.name: galleryEvidence.pairs
inputs.description: Optional after-to-before audio pair map, defaulting to audioPairs(items).

inputs.name: reportFilter.filter
inputs.description: Search text and optional exact category, phase and status filters.

inputs.name: reportFilter.pairs
inputs.description: Optional after-to-before pair map allowing either member to satisfy all filters.

inputs.name: projectFilter.run
inputs.description: Report to test for a project-list match.

inputs.name: projectFilter.project
inputs.description: Optional exact project identifier; empty accepts all projects.

outputs.name: screenSize
outputs.description: Mobile/tablet/desktop from known words first, otherwise the first numeric width with boundaries at 700 and 1100; other when no positive width is found.

outputs.name: galleryEvidence
outputs.description: All non-before items plus unpaired before-audio items. Paired before audio and all before images are hidden as separate gallery entries.

outputs.name: reportFilter
outputs.description: Matches where either the item or its paired before item satisfies all filters, sorted by order with missing order treated as zero. Search spans title, notes, category, viewport, source and transcript.

outputs.name: projectFilter
outputs.description: True when project selection matches and the lowercased project name, title or summary contains the query.
